mixes.title: Shan-D (hosted by Snowy, Trilla and Asas) Boogie Daves 60TH
mixes.description:
1 hour DJ set from Shan-D, hosted by Grime MC's Snowy, Trilla and Asas.

This was performed at Birminghams infamous Boogie Dave's 60th Birthday party at Suki10c club on 4th September 2026.

Enjoy the dubstep/grime 140 mix.
